purpose: Use external systems as learning references while requiring DreamCo implementations and creative outputs to be independently developed and provenance-aware.
learning_principles: Study documented techniques and public research.
Use permissively licensed code only when license obligations are satisfied.
Prefer independent reimplementation from concepts and specifications rather than copying implementation text.
Record sources, licenses, versions, and attribution requirements.
Do not present third-party code, assets, datasets, voices, or characters as DreamCo-owned material.
Build DreamCo-specific benchmarks and objectives beyond reproducing existing systems.
creative_output_rules: Prefer original prompts, scripts, compositions, characters, assets, and production pipelines.
Require authorization for real-person voice or likeness workflows.
Do not intentionally reproduce copyrighted works when the workflow lacks authorization or an applicable legal basis.
engineering_goal: Learn from the ecosystem, understand why approaches work, then create independently engineered DreamCo systems that can be tested against the same goals and improved beyond existing baselines.
